rows.notes: [T084] Resolves the T009 ESCALATE (company-wide 35.5 GWh parked on this row). Company annual report (S2, HKEX, 2026-04-23): 10 GWh newly commenced in 2025, total capacity 35.5 GWh at year-end; Phase II 15 GWh (S3) and a further 20 GWh storage project (S4) at the new Changshu plant. Why 35.5 is a fair Changshu figure: the Changshu plant is stated as 25 GWh in 2023 (S1) and the company total was 25.5 GWh when the placing was announced Oct-2025 (S6), so at most ~0.5 GWh (1.4%) of the 35.5 total can sit outside the original Changshu plant (the Nanjing base, whose HEV lines the AR says were impaired); the 2025 +10 GWh is Phase I of the new Changshu plant (S6; AR Phase II wording S3 and use-of-proceeds table S5). installed basis: company, company-wide total (all sites) with the Changshu share inferred as >= 35.0 GWh; within the 15% tolerance, so no cap. Nameplate 70.5 = 35.5 installed + Phase II 15 (S3, due 'Before 31 December 2027' per S5) + 20 GWh storage project on the Phase II premises (S4, undated) - D-014; ref_year 2027: latest dated phase; remainder undated (the Oct-2025 placing article S6 said Phase II would finish end-2026; the later AR table S5 says 31 Dec 2027 and wins). capacity_by_year_json: dropped the v1/T009 2026 = 50.5 step because that is the superseded Oct-2025 plan (D-017); the 2023 = 25 step is the plant design capacity at start (S1), 2025 = 35.5 the AR figure; no Phase II step is entered because its completion year conflicts (end-2026 vs end-2027) and is undated in the 20 GWh project. CONFLICT noted and not used: ESS News 2026-03-23 (S7) says ~45 GWh commissioned across 'Suzhou, Nanjing, Ganzhou, and Yibin' - single English outlet, 27% above the company's own AR figure, and names sites Zenergy does not list in its AR; the AR (company, later) wins per CONVENTIONS. start_year 2023 from S1 (plant started operations in Changshu; page dated 2023-05-15; T073 had the 2023-05-09 date). Not touched: chemistry/end_market (v1, reported tier, flagged by T031); cell_format null. Remaining uncertainty: no site-level breakdown of the 35.5 GWh, Phase II timing.

[T084] Confidence 0.4 -> 0.62: the 50 GWh long-duration storage project and its 'intention agreement' status are now confirmed by the company's own FY2025 annual report (S8, 2026-04-23) and by two press outlets (ESS News S9/S10; Jiemian S11, Chinese). Status announced (D-020): intention agreement only; ESS News S10 says phase 1 construction starts in H2 2026 - no construction report found (a Chinese search on 2026-11-24 returned nothing after the March signing). nameplate 50 = two 25 GWh phases (S9: 'Phase two will add another 25 GWh'; phase 1 25 GWh per ESS News). ref_year 2028 = phase 2 completion (S9; phase 1 production Q3 2027, S10): latest dated phase. LOCATION CONFLICT (unresolved, not affecting capacity/status): ESS News (S9/S10 page) places the project in Suzhou Xiangcheng Economic and Technological Development Zone, whereas Jiemian (S11) says it settled in Suzhou Changshu High-tech Zone (苏州常熟高新区); the AR (S8) names no location. The row's id/plant_name say Xiangcheng, so the plant_name should be treated as provisional; Changshu High-tech Zone is a different zone from the existing Changshu plant (Southeast zone) but this was not verified, so it is kept as a separate row (not merged into the Changshu row); the 20 GWh storage project in the AR (S4 on Changshu row) is a different, smaller project on Phase II premises. Investment differs by outlet (RMB 10bn Jiemian vs ~5.2bn ESS News) - not used. Product: 588Ah large-format cells (long-duration ESS) so it is cell capacity, not bundled. Long-duration chemistry may fall under data/reference/non_comparable.csv - not decided here. Coordinates remain null.
